statements.statement: The service billed was mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229
The denial reason code was CO-197
The clinical indication was recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient had a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture arrhythmic burden and correlate rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms
The service was denied for missing prior authorization
Prior authorization was required by plan terms
